articles.title: Comparing Taobao, Tmall and 1688 options for one iTaoBuy find
articles.description: iTaoBuy names Taobao, Tmall and 1688 among the marketplaces it serves.

sections.heading: Put the offers on the same footing
paragraphs: iTaoBuy names Taobao, Tmall and 1688 among the marketplaces it serves. When similar photos appear across those sites, compare what each selected option buys. Start with one product specification and one required quantity. A single piece, a pair, a sample and a case can all appear under a similar image with different advertised prices.

sections.heading: Look inside the option list
paragraphs: For each candidate, write down the seller, precise selected variant, number of pieces, minimum quantity if displayed, and what accessories are included. Test the combination you actually want. A price attached to the least expensive swatch can have little relevance to the finished product. If the listing offers several lengths or materials, record the full label before pasting the link into iTaoBuy.

sections.heading: Compute the useful unit cost
paragraphs: Suppose one offer contains two containers for 30 yuan and another contains three for 39 yuan. The first costs 15 per container, the second 13, before delivery. If you need only two and cannot use the third, compare the cash you must actually spend as well. Add any quoted domestic delivery and consider whether the larger pack changes the eventual parcel dimensions.

sections.heading: Decide using the unresolved questions
paragraphs: Keep the seller that gives a clear specification, useful measurements and an option that survives the transfer into the agent order screen. For a close decision, ask each seller the same precise question through the available channel. Save the answer with its offer. Clear evidence of the right item can matter more than a small price difference between two listings whose contents are still uncertain.

sections.heading: Compare the offer at the quantity you need
paragraphs: A useful comparison for ten identical storage hooks differs from one for a single replacement. On a listing with quantity tiers, select the order quantity you would actually purchase and check whether the price changes. Confirm whether the number refers to individual pieces, retail packs or cartons. If a seller calls one unit a set of two, multiplying the requested pieces by the pack price will overstate the total. Conversely, comparing a sample price with a retail pair can make a bulk listing appear artificially inexpensive.

For a closer example, imagine that seller A offers single boxes at 12 units each plus 8 units domestic delivery. Seller B offers a pack of four for 42 with 12 domestic delivery. Buying four from A would cost 56 before overseas freight; buying one pack from B would cost 54. The apparent merchandise advantage has narrowed to two units after domestic transport. Check the included lids, material and dimensions before deciding those two figures represent comparable goods.

sections.heading: Use seller answers as part of the specification
paragraphs: Ask the same factual question of the shortlisted sellers. For stackable containers, that might be the internal depth under the fitted lid or the base dimension that matters for a shelf. Save the answer beside each variant with the date. If a seller offers only styled photos while another provides a measurement that matches your available shelf space, the evidence changes the comparison. Return to the final iTaoBuy order screen and check that the selected option, number of units and displayed total still correspond to the offer you researched.

sections.heading: Determine whether the reference photograph depicts the offer
paragraphs: A seller may show a complete display arrangement in the lead photograph while selling the base, lid and dividers as separate variants. Compare the option-specific image with the written contents. For a desktop organizer, a cheaper option could be an additional tray that has little use without the frame. Clicking the visually attractive photo without reading the option list can leave you comparing a complete unit on one marketplace with a replacement part on another.

Use the seller's own product dimensions and contents for each variant. If a product must fit an existing space, record the maximum usable external dimension and the minimum internal space as separate requirements. A larger outside width can come from thick walls rather than usable space. For a stacking system, the mounting or interlocking geometry may matter more than the part's headline size. Ask for a diagram or photograph of the connection you need and compare your existing component before paying.

sections.heading: Test the effect of quantity on price and shipping
paragraphs: A bulk offer can appear compelling at its lowest displayed unit price. Check which order quantity unlocks that price and whether the seller accepts the smaller number you actually want. If you can only order a full carton, calculate the price of the carton and identify where the unused units would go. A lower cost per piece can still mean a higher cash outlay, larger parcel and more unwanted goods. Keep the price at your intended quantity as the figure used in the main comparison.

For a shared purchase, confirm everyone's quantity before selecting a tier. Imagine a group needs nine boxes, while a seller's next pack size contains twelve. Divide the full landed budget across nine useful units if the extra three have no planned buyer. Then compare that figure with a seller offering exactly nine. If the group can use the extras, make that assumption explicit and allocate their cost to the people taking them. Avoid assigning imaginary resale value to surplus items to make a deal appear affordable.

sections.heading: Check domestic transport and the proposed warehouse process
paragraphs: Find out what domestic delivery charge the actual order screen returns after quantity selection. A seller might quote a different amount for one pack, several packs or goods shipped to different regions. Where multiple products come from one seller, ask whether they will be dispatched together and, if so, whether each line will remain identifiable in the resulting parcel. An apparently inexpensive item can require substantial protective space when shipped abroad.

Read the evidence you would have at warehouse intake. For a seller shipping cartons of individually packed parts, can the quantity be verified from external markings, or would a sealed package need opening? For a customized or made-to-order option, confirm its specification and how any error would be addressed before purchase. If one seller offers a clear product diagram and an identifiable variant while another uses generic labels, that difference can affect the time and effort needed to verify the order even when the price is similar.

sections.heading: Make the choice repeatable for a future order
paragraphs: Save a small decision record with the selected seller, exact option, number of units bought and why the offer won. Include one rejected alternative and its decisive difference. For example, the rejected pack might have been cheaper per piece but too wide for the allocated shelf, or it might have used a different lid connection. Avoid a vague ranking of whole marketplaces based on a single transaction. The useful conclusion identifies the offer that met your requirements on the date you checked.

When it is time to reorder, compare the new live offer against this record rather than automatically buying from an old shortcut. Product families, option names, quantities and shipping arrangements can change. If the first order reached you, measure the actual product and update the record with observed dimensions and packaging. Those observations will make the next comparison stronger than the original seller photos alone, while still leaving room to recheck anything the seller has changed in the meantime.

sections.heading: Read translations with the option images
paragraphs: When seller text is translated automatically, two materially different choices can acquire the same short English name. Compare the original option text, variant code and selected image. If both translations say cover, one may refer to the lid while the other refers to a complete enclosure. Ask about the exact parts included using a short annotated picture if necessary. Save the answer with the chosen offer so a later reorder from the same product page can be matched to the correct underlying variant.

sources.title: Independent guide to researching spreadsheet finds

faq.q: Where do I paste an original marketplace link on iTaoBuy?
faq.a: Use the product search field on the official site. After it loads, check the seller, item and options against the source listing before placing an order.

faq.q: How do I tell if an old spreadsheet row has changed?
faq.a: Compare the live listing number, seller, option labels and package quantity with the saved row. A familiar image can remain after the seller changes the offer.

faq.q: Can I order from Taobao, Tmall or 1688 through iTaoBuy?
faq.a: The official homepage names all three. Check that the particular listing loads and that your preferred option can be selected.

faq.q: Why does the price change when I select a color?
faq.a: A listing may group different sizes, packs or accessories under the same product. Compare the amount shown for the complete selected option with its written contents.

faq.q: What if the listing shows a pack but the selected option says one piece?
faq.a: Clarify the sold unit before paying. Save the option text and request confirmation of how many pieces the selected price includes.

faq.q: How should I compare a shirt's chest measurement?
faq.a: First establish whether the chart uses flat width or circumference. Measure a shirt you own using the same endpoints and units.

faq.q: Will a warehouse size-label check prove that a garment fits?
faq.a: The label identifies a size designation. Fit depends on the actual garment dimensions, its cut and your preferred amount of room.

faq.q: Where do iTaoBuy QC photos come from?
faq.a: The developer describes taking QC photos after receipt at its warehouse. Compare photos associated with your own order to the selected variant.

faq.q: What photo should I request for a missing bag strap?
faq.a: Ask whether the warehouse can show the bag, both ends of the removable strap and the attachment rings together. Include the order reference and seller's description of the included parts.

faq.q: How can I investigate a color discrepancy?
faq.a: Compare the selected color name and product tag, then ask for another view if lighting could explain the difference. Keep the original images with your request.

faq.q: Does my first product payment include overseas shipping?
faq.a: The developer distinguishes product and logistics charges. Review the order receipt and the later parcel quote to identify precisely what each payment covers.

faq.q: How do I compare a card charge with the order total?
faq.a: Match the transaction reference, amount, payment date and currency. Keep a separate record of any conversion or charge shown by the payment provider.

faq.q: Where can I estimate iTaoBuy shipping?
faq.a: Use the official freight estimator with the destination and the best available packed measurements. Save your inputs to compare with the final parcel details.

faq.q: What box measurements should I use for a freight comparison?
faq.a: Use the outside dimensions of the proposed packed carton. Label estimates clearly and replace them with warehouse measurements when available.

faq.q: Can iTaoBuy combine products into one parcel?
faq.a: The official site describes selecting stored products for a single parcel. Compare packing compatibility and the actual available routes before selecting items.

faq.q: Should I wait for a late item before combining orders?
faq.a: Check the deadlines for the items already stored, then compare shipping them now with the possible combined parcel. The late item's dimensions and dispatch time may be uncertain.

faq.q: What if domestic tracking shows delivery but no QC photo appears?
faq.a: Send the domestic tracking number, seller order reference and delivery timestamp to support. Ask whether the parcel has been matched to the warehouse entry.

faq.q: Why does a seller order show only one of two items at the warehouse?
faq.a: Check the received quantity and ask whether the seller split the shipment. Match each outstanding item to its own dispatch record.

faq.q: Can I ask about an exchange before overseas shipment?
faq.a: Contact the agent through the order while the item remains at the warehouse. Ask which remedy, deadline and domestic costs apply to the specific seller and variant.

faq.q: Which reference should I use to follow my international parcel?
faq.a: Use the tracking number in the submitted international parcel record. Seller dispatch references normally describe an earlier domestic journey.

faq.q: How should I compare two listings with different pack sizes?
faq.a: Calculate both the cost per piece and the cash required for the quantity you will actually order. Add quoted domestic delivery and account for any extra packaging.
